exact_statement: For the independent three-input Boolean mux (1-z)y0+z y1 at every fixed interior address probability q, the exact supremum of corrected Hplus/(I-Var) over the two interior data means is K(q)=2+2[1+g(max(q,1-q))]/ln2, g(t)=t ln(1/t)/(1-t); the global sharp constant is Kstar=2+4/ln2. For a two-reused-wire mux controlled by b, exact disjoint composition has profile multiplier beta=(1-m0*m1)/2, rather than t^2. Every arbitrary-fan-in parity-controlled mux and disjoint read-once formula over these gates and established AND/OR/parity gates satisfies corrected Hplus<=Kstar Delta under every product input law, uniformly in depth and fan-in. exact_statement: For the sign majority-three gate under every independent interior Bernoulli product law, natural corrected entropy E=(ln2)Hplus satisfies E <= (4+ln4)(I-Var) - (ln4-1)P({1,2,3}). Its exact all-bias supremum Hplus/(I-Var) is 2+4/ln2, not attained in the interior, and approached at probabilities (1-t^3,t,t). The result is invariant under input permutations/reflections with reflected biases and output negation. At a unanimous deterministic vertex with rare deviations e,u,v, the ratio is 2+O(delta ln(1/delta)); at a mixed vertex represented by probabilities (1-e,u,v), the ratio is 2+(2/ln2)(1+uv/[e(u+v)+uv])+O(delta ln(1/delta)), where delta=max(e,u,v) and each absolute error is at most 400 delta ln(1/delta) for delta<=1/8, with no restriction on relative rates. Codimension-two fixed-interior-r edge formulas are (12)-(13) of REPORT.md; their remainders are uniform only on compact r-subintervals. All deterministic boundary functions are contracted before zero-deficit division. No arbitrary-arity prime or universal FEI theorem is established.
